verdict.rationale: New Relic is an observability SaaS platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. Its official docs announce an MCP server that connects AI development tools to New Relic context and converts plain-English questions into NRQL, and a probe confirms the documented official MCP server. Evidence comes only from a what's-new announcement. Missing for 10: detailed setup/auth and tool-list documentation, client configuration guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
